3. Mr. Naveen Chandra Arya, Advocate for respondent nos.2 to 5.
4.

This petition was filed for quashing of FIR dated 27.02.2024 as well as the entire proceedings of Special Sessions Trial No.30/2022 under Section 363, 366A, 376 IPC and 5/6 of POCSO Act,
pending in the court of F.T.C./Special Court (POCSO), Additional Sessions Judge, Dehradun in view of the compromise arrived at between the parties.
5.

In view of the fact that a Compounding Application was filed by the parties before this Court, this Court, vide order dated 22.10.2024, had directed the parties to appear before the Secretary, DLSA,
Dehradun in order to get their statements recorded and to verify the compromise deed.

6. Pursuant to such order, Secretary, DLSA, Dehradun has submitted his report dated 25.10.2024 which indicates that the parties have settled the dispute amicably and have also verified the contents of the compromise.
7. In view of the above, Compounding Application IA No.7/2024 is allowed.

As a consequence thereof, FIR dated 27.02.2024 and the entire proceedings of Special Sessions Trial No.30/2022 under Section 2024:UHC:8399 363, 366A, 376 IPC and 5/6 of POCSO Act, pending in the court of F.T.C./Special Court (POCSO), Additional Sessions Judge, Dehradun are hereby quashed qua the petitioners.

8. Present petition u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is, thus, disposed of in terms of compromise arrived at between C482/1444/2023 on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143807222/
1 the parties.
9. All pending applications also stand disposed of accordingly.
